newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Conseco, Western up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Conseco, Western up.

text.p: Conseco Inc shares climbed sharply preceding Tuesday's market open as buyers stepped up after learning the stock will be added to the Standard & Poor's 500 Index as of the close of trade today.
Conseco traded at 72 before the open, up from the 66-7/8 notched at Monday's NYSE close, traders said.
Strong quarterly earnings drove up Western Digital Corp shares after last night's market close, though the stock slipped slightly off the after-hours peak, traders said.
Western closed NYSE trade Monday at 68-3/8, then drove up to 72 after reporting fiscal second quarter income of $1.35 per share versus $0.75 one year ago.
Early Tuesday, Western preserved a three-point rise from the prior close, trading at 71-3/8.
"Western reported great earnings but was up 10 points all week ahead of the numbers," a traders said, explaining the slip from 72.
Boca Research Inc stock broke down to 7-3/4 from 10 before the open, investors soured by the company's admission last night that fourth quarter income will be about $0.03 per share.
"The last sale was 10 last night, and anything above 8 today would shock me," a trader said.
According to Zack's Investment Research, analysts' consensus expectation for the computer modem maker's fourth quarter was $0.26 per share in earnings.
Intel climbed to 148 from 146-7/8, cracking the year-high 147-3/4 early Tuesday.
Traders attributed the ascent to market anticipation of robust quarterly results from Intel, due after today's close.
The computer chip maker is expected to report income of $1.84 versus $0.98 a year ago.
"If the number does not come in over $2.00 (per share), the stock is going to get whacked," said a trader, referring to climbing expectations for Intel's results.
